name: Marching Cubes Surface Point Extraction
definition: A compute shader kernel that extracts surface points for a voxel grid by determining which edges of a cube are intersected by the isosurface and calculating the intersection point using one of three strategies: Quadratic Error Function (QEF), Centroid, or Blocky (cube center).
summary: Marching Cubes Surface Point Extraction computes 3D isosurface points per voxel by intersecting grid edges and aggregating results via QEF, Centroid, or Blocky strategies for GPU efficiency.
